subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When authenticating a completed review artifact, the verifier shall treat the persistence adapter's code-host transport principal as non-authoritative: it need not differ from the implementation or operator principal and shall neither establish nor refute artifact authenticity; authenticity shall derive from the exact adapter receipt plus protected attempt proof, represented by separate non-secret references in every verified publication terminal. This rule shall not alter FR-16's author-attribution requirement for later operator-class finding dispositions.
rationale: artifact location, artifact authorship, producer proof, and operator disposition authorship are distinct predicates; a shared transport account must not create a bot-credential distribution requirement or weaken disposition calibration
fit_criterion: same-author and different-author artifact transport both verify only when the distinct native receipt and attempt-proof reference resolve and match; receipt/proof aliasing or substitution fails; operator-disposition attribution fixtures remain byte-identical and still exclude unattributable operator acts
